headline: Saginaw Valley State's unbeaten start ends against Northern Michigan
dek: Saginaw Valley State's unbeaten start ended at home to Northern Michigan, a side they had beaten earlier in the month. Three wins and two draws came before the defeat. It leaves Roosevelt and Purdue Northwest as the GLIAC's only sides yet to lose.
displaced_by: results night: Northern Michigan's win ended Saginaw Valley State's unbeaten start, the only result of the night to change a season-level fact
